episodeTitle.en: Linear’s secret to building beloved B2B products | Nan Yu (Head of Product)
episodeTitle.zh: Linear打造备受喜爱的B2B产品的秘诀 | 余南（Nan Yu，产品负责人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Nan Yu is the head of product at Linear, one of the most beloved and fastest-growing B2B SaaS products out there today, and the gold standard for high-performing tech teams. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why speed and quality aren’t actually at odds
guestBioOfficial.zh: 余南是Linear的产品负责人，Linear是当今最受欢迎、发展最快的B2B SaaS产品之一，也是高绩效技术团队的标杆。在对谈中，我们讨论了：• 速度与质量为何并非矛盾

title.en: Linear’s secret to building beloved B2B products | Nan Yu (Head of Product)
title.zh: Linear打造备受喜爱的B2B产品的秘诀 | 余南（Nan Yu，产品负责人）

summary.en: Nan argues speed and quality are not a trade-off - top crafters' output quality is visible in how fast they move. He describes having a working hypothesis tested internally within the first ~10% of a project's time. The episode covers how Linear says no to features to avoid bloat and keep ICs happy.
summary.zh: 南认为速度与质量并非折中关系——顶尖匠人的产出质量，正体现在他们推进的速度上。他描述了一个做法：在项目前约 10% 的时间内，就拿出可工作的版本、在内部验证关键假设。本期涵盖了 Linear 如何通过拒绝功能来避免臃肿、让一线工程师满意。
